end.parentNote: Asha practised neutralisation using ant bites, antacids, and the reaction between hydrochloric acid and sodium hydroxide. Khushi used the method of connecting the idea to familiar examples and correctly recalled salt, water, and heat in several responses. They initially mixed up whether every acid–base mixture is dangerous and whether all salt formed is common salt; this was partly clarified through the examples, but the final teach-back was not yet secure. At home, ask Khushi to explain one example using the frame: acid + base → salt + water + heat.
